def evolved_p89(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i] = popcount(i): number of 1-bits in binary representation of i.
    # Pure function of position index i -> compute locally, no collective needed.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device).to(x.dtype)
    count = torch.zeros(N, device=x.device).to(x.dtype)
    n_bits = 8  # enough bits to cover N=128 (2^7=128)
    cur = idx
    for b in range(n_bits):
        bit = cur % 2
        count = count + bit
        cur = cur // 2
    return count.contiguous().to(x.dtype)
